# GH Aura

> AI-first, model-agnostic GitHub profile design. Build original professional READMEs using evidence, biographies and composable sources. No templates, paid AI API or hosted service required.

## For any agent
- [Portable Agent Skill](skills/gh-aura-profile/SKILL.md)
- [Agent instructions](AGENTS.md)
- [CLI & MCP setup](docs/CLI.md)
- [Privacy and publication safety](SECURITY.md)

## Tools
- `gh-aura mcp`: local stdio; source search, layout techniques, biography guidance, profile plans/refinement, Markdown validation, read-only GitHub context and previews.
- `gh-aura sources recommend --query "biografía" --json`: curated references.
- `gh-aura sources design --query "terminal retro" --json`: GitHub-compatible visual techniques and source links.
- `gh-aura agent bio --voice technical --focus engineering`: biography guide.
- `gh-aura agent spec --direction expressive --visual-brief "..."`: editable original design intent.
- `gh-aura brief --prompt`: portable model-agnostic writing brief.
- `GH_AURA_SOURCES_FILE`: optional trusted local catalog; sources remain opt-in.

## Publication boundary
AI-facing tools cannot publish. Only the human independently runs `gh-aura preview --file draft.md --save review.json` and `gh-aura apply --review review.json --pr`.
